objective: Close the behavioral gap where the model verbally rejects stale/planned evidence yet still reuses one stale operand inside arithmetic. Enforce operand-level provenance checking at calculation time for consequential optimization without blocking calculations whose material inputs are verified.

roles_before.artifact: PROTOCOL.md already states that a derived current claim inherits the weakest provenance of material inputs and forbids filling missing current inputs from stale/planned evidence.
skills/total-value-optimizer.md owns the concrete cross-cutting optimization procedure used for consequential multidimensional choices.
The optimizer may quantify when credible current inputs support arithmetic, ranges, thresholds or scenarios.
Mutable facts remain with exact domain/live owners; procedural skills own no mutable state.
PROTOCOL.md and the optimizer stop rule prevent needless checking when an unknown cannot change the decision.
Git history and v1/v2 stress evidence preserve both the pre-fix rule and its production behavioral failure.

role_dispositions.destination: Keep the compact global invariant unchanged; the observed defect is compliance at arithmetic execution time, not absence of the concept.

Add one execution-level calculation gate to the existing comparison-structure step: identify material operands and provenance before present-tense arithmetic; stale/planned/unknown operands cannot support a current point estimate.
When all material operands are verified for the relevant horizon, ordinary arithmetic remains allowed.
No new factual owner or live-source authority is introduced.
The gate is internal and limited to material operands; irrelevant stale facts do not trigger extra retrieval or block a decision.
Git history plus dated regression results retain the exact failure sequence and previous rule.
Extend the derived-provenance guard to assert optimizer-level operand auditing and the verified-input contra case.

capability_probes.assertion: A fully observed current schedule must still permit workload arithmetic.
Even if the answer says stale Calendar data are not authoritative, it must not silently reuse Calendar-only 07:30 as an operand for current workload.
A stale field that is not a material operand must not block unrelated current arithmetic or force unnecessary questions.
The v1 deployed rule, failed production replay, and all prior stress evidence remain recoverable in Git/tests.

tests.expected: PASS: optimizer procedure contains operand-level provenance gate; reference cases reject hidden stale operand reuse and allow fully verified arithmetic.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py && python tests/total_value_optimizer_guard.py

verification.behavioral_status: The v1 production replay failed: it stated Calendar was not truth yet computed 66.5 h/week by implicitly reusing the stale 07:30 start. This v2 candidate targets that execution-time hidden-operand failure specifically.
